newsitem.title: ITALY: Scalfaro attacks attempts to divide Italy.
newsitem.headline: Scalfaro attacks attempts to divide Italy.

text.p: President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro made a stinging attack on Sunday against attempts to divide Italy.
"Heaven help those who work to divide, tear apart, to put into doubt a patrimony that is presupposed on peaceful co-habitation...," Scalfaro said.

In a speech marking Italy's Armed Forces Day and Italy's National Unity Day on Monday, Scalfaro did not specifically mention Umberto Bossi, leader of the separatist Northern League, who last September declared "independence" for his would-be northern republic of "Padania".

"A propoganda offensive persists against the dignity of our history which which wants to undermine our national unity," the president said. "These positions are a serious incitement against untouchable and sacred values."

The Northern League won an unexpected 10.7 percent in Italy's general election in April, but opinion polls show that, despite deep frustration with high taxes and a perceived incompetent central bureaucracy, most northerners firmly oppose secession.
